_comment: DRAFTS pending owner listen test. Nothing at runtime reads this file — it is the reviewable source for the /quiz MP3s the offline true/false game plays from SD (esp32 offline_quiz.cpp). The answer is encoded in the RENDERED FILENAME (qNN-y.mp3 / qNN-n.mp3), which is what makes the game genuinely verifiable offline: the toy compares the GREEN/RED button press against the filename, no cloud, no model.
_toneRules: Same register as game mode v6 yes_no_silly: singular «դու» child register, exactly ONE question mark per question, no paired «Հա՞, թե՞ ոչ» tag (the question alone invites the answer), nothing scary, no learning-goal lecture tone. Questions must be answerable by a 4-year-old from everyday knowledge — no trick questions, no regional knowledge.
_balance: 10 yes / 10 no, shuffled so the answers never alternate in a guessable pattern.

feedback.text: Լավ խաղացինք։ Մյուս անգամ նորից կխաղանք։

_renderNote: Render in the same voice as the welcome-flow clips. Filenames: /quiz/q01-n.mp3 (q01 answer=no), /quiz/q02-y.mp3, … /quiz/win.mp3, /quiz/wrong.mp3, /quiz/done.mp3. Sample ONE question and the three feedback lines for the owner's listen test BEFORE batch-rendering the set.
